arcs.title: The Duck Bandit
arcs.summary: Day 3: The copper-green thread has been traced by the Department of Magical Fibres to old-growth upland pine on the eastern ridge above the gorge, pre-1980 charm-work, a practitioner who learned before Ministry licensing. Steve found a tin of Eastern Ridge Blend wood conditioner (circa 1978) behind the third shed shelf — now on the kitchen table. Lucy's sustained, deliberate interest in the thread jar has been formally noted as a data point. The fifth duck has not yet appeared but is expected; its hat should be the most elaborate yet. Day 4 should bring the Bandit's shape into near-focus — perhaps Lucy leads Christine or Steve toward something, or the duck appears with a hat that contains a legible detail — without the full reveal. The eastern ridge and the 1978 conditioner tin are the live threads.
